limitations: Six fixed axis perturbations on one development drive; convergence/parity do not establish independent calibration accuracy.
Historical CPU results are comparison oracles for numerical payloads, not paired timing measurements.

methods.label: Fused Numba CPU, two frame threads

metrics.interpretation: 1 means exact equality with the historical complete numerical payload.
metrics.label: Complete numerical payload parity
metrics.name: numerical_parity

metrics.interpretation: Solver evaluation count for this fixed signed-axis problem.
metrics.label: Evaluations
metrics.name: evaluation_count

protocol.failure_policy: Retain each candidate, including nonconvergence or a numerical mismatch.
protocol.initial_estimate_policy: Dataset reference plus local Euler rotation +/-0.5 deg and camera-frame translation +/-0.5 m, on x, y, z in that order. Controlled prior; reference is never the optimization target.
protocol.split_policy: Six fixed signed-axis initializations on the same uniform 20-fit/5-holdout provider frames; repetitions are timing observations, not independent recovery trials.
protocol.tuning_policy: All cases/settings fixed before execution; no holdout tuning or filtering.
